verdict.rationale: LightSprint documents creating tasks directly from Linear or Jira with two-way sync. It also says it tracks PRs and manages ticket state, which covers the core of agents working against tickets in the PM's existing tracker. The evidence is a single marketing line on the pricing page, and only two of the four named trackers are listed. Missing for 10: explicit ClickUp and Monday.com support (the generic 1,000+ MCP integrations claim names neither), in-depth setup docs for the tracker integrations, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the bidirectional sync.
